text.en:
BRUNEI DARUSSALAM GOVERNMENT GAZETTE No. S 63

EXCISE DUTIES ORDER, 2007 (S 26/07)

NOTIFICATION OF COMMENCEMENT UNDER PARAGRAPH 1 In exercise of the power conferred by paragraph 1, the Minister of Finance, with the approval of His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan, has appointed the 1st. January, 2008 as the date on which the Excise Duties Order, 2007 shall commence. Dated 12th. day of Zulhijjah, 1428 Hijriah corresponding to the 22nd. day of . December, 2007. AWANG HAJI MOHD. ROZAN BIN DATO PADUKA HAJI MOHD. YUNOS Acting Permanent Secretary, Ministry of Finance, Brunei Darussalam.
